-- TYPE MISMATCH ------------------------------------ main.fango

This argument has type:

    Int -> String -> Int

but `List.foldl` expects:

    Int -> String -> String

4| main() = print (List.foldl { total word -> total + String.length word } 0 ["a", "bb"])
                              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

`List.foldl` has type:

    (a -> b ->{e} b) -> b -> List a ->{e} b

-- TYPE MISMATCH ------------------------------------ main.fango

This argument is a number, but `List.foldl` expects:

    String

4| main() = print (List.foldl { total word -> total + String.length word } 0 ["a", "bb"])
                                                                           ^

-- TYPE MISMATCH ------------------------------------ main.fango

This argument has type:

    List String

but `List.foldl` expects:

    List Int

4| main() = print (List.foldl { total word -> total + String.length word } 0 ["a", "bb"])
                                                                             ^^^^^^^^^^^
